items.job: Replace piston rings, or replace the engine
items.note: CarComplaints owners report typical costs of about $1,300 to $2,300. A used engine is often cheaper than rebuilding.
RepairPal estimates an A/C recharge at $249 to $329. Fixing a leak or replacing the compressor costs more.

items.job: Recall repair of the airbag system
Replace with a used or rebuilt transmission
items.note: CarComplaints lists an average owner cost of about $700, mostly for used units.

items.t: Misfire with check engine light on
items.job: Replace spark plugs, wires, cap and rotor
items.note: CarComplaints lists an average owner cost of about $200.

items.t: Seat belt warning light flashes or stays on
items.job: Replace front seat belt buckle or assembly
items.note: Owners were quoted about $235 to $300 for the full seat belt.

items.t: Airbags failed to deploy in a crash
items.job: Scan and diagnose the airbag (SRS) system
items.note: RepairPal lists electrical diagnosis at $122 to $179. A clockspring replacement runs $520 to $600.

items.t: Worn tie rod ends cause shake or loose steering
items.note: RepairPal estimates $131 to $171. Add a wheel alignment afterward.

items.t: Clunk from the stabilizer bar links

items.note: RepairPal estimates $1,408 to $1,756 for a 2002 Prizm.
RepairPal lists general diagnosis at $122 to $179. A wheel speed sensor or ABS part is extra.

items.t: Seat belts don't retract or latch properly
items.note: Owners of a 2000 Prizm were quoted about $235 to more than $300 to replace a whole front belt.

items.t: ABS kicks in at the wrong time
items.job: Read ABS codes and inspect wheel speed sensors
items.note: RepairPal lists general diagnosis at $122 to $179. Parts are extra.

items.t: Hesitation or stalling with check engine light
items.note: RepairPal lists $122 to $179 for diagnosis, $146 to $163 for a MAP sensor and $210 to $233 for an oxygen sensor.
